docs.message:
docs: biz42 diff in the preview and the PR comment, model checks before commit

## Intent

Reviewers should see what changed in biz42, as they already do for the platform design. A model should never change its blocks without its prose unnoticed, so the model checks run before every commit.

## Key changes

- The preview contains about-diff/: the organisation's changes since the merge base as a page, like the platform design's.
- One comment per pull request ("Docs review") links the preview and both change pages and lists the changed elements of each model.
- .githooks/pre-commit validates a touched model and runs its diff --staged.
- Tool versions live in scripts/versions.sh, shared by build and hook.
- biz42 0.11 needs one-line scope fields and the prefix impr- for improvements.
